concerns.analysis: The source document contains the agency logo ('NC Information Technology') at the top left of page 1. This logo is completely missing from the HTML output, and because there are no other instances of this logo preserved in the document, its absence constitutes a failure to preserve an identifying agency logo.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: NC Information Technology logo at the top left of page 1
concerns.output_quote: The logo is completely absent from the HTML output

concerns.description: Images placed next to wrong text
concerns.analysis: On page 3, the images are significantly jumbled and placed next to the wrong text. In the source PDF, the 'PCI DSS COMPLIANT' logo is placed next to the text about the NC Office of the State Controller (OSC) promoting E-commerce/PCI Data Security Standards. In the HTML output, this image is placed much further down, after the 'Other important events coming soon...' list. Conversely, the 'Useful Links' graphic, which belongs next to the Cybersecurity links further down in the PDF, is placed above
concerns.source_pdf_quote: The PCI DSS COMPLIANT logo appears next to the text 'The NC Office of the State Controller (OSC) is promoting...'
concerns.output_quote: The 'PCI DSS COMPLIANT' logo appears after the 'Other important events coming soon...' list, completely separated from the OSC text.
